editorNote: Two model stories dominate. Mistral published open weights for Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, and press frames it as a coding leader among open models; treat the rankings as vendor-adjacent until you test it. Separately, Gemini 4 Carbon took first place on the Artificial Analysis index and launched for cyber defenders. OpenAI also updated its Model Spec and described how it detects misalignment.
